$comment: Scraper integration test files that the pr-gate job `scraper-document-integration`
deliberately does NOT run. Enforced by scripts/ci/require-integration-test-coverage.mjs:
every file under scraper/tests/integration/ must be in the job's run list or in here.
kind 'cannot-run-in-ci' = hits a live external site / needs the prod tunnel / needs a
credential CI does not have. kind 'broken' = cannot currently run anywhere; it needs a
tracking issue, because a broken test hiding inside 'excluded' is exactly the silence
Paths are relative to scraper/ and must name one file exactly — no wildcards.

exclusions.reason: Calls testNSEAPIConnection() and scrapeNSEAPI() against the LIVE nseindia.com API (cookie handshake, real rate limits). A CI runner's IP is blocked by NSE and the result would be non-deterministic; it is a manual connectivity probe, not a gate.

Builds its own pool from web/.env.local, i.e. the PRODUCTION database through the SSH tunnel — it bypasses DATABASE_URL and therefore also the vitest.integration.setup.ts db-safety-guard. CI has neither the file nor the tunnel, and must never have them. Runs on a developer laptop with the tunnel up. Re-pointing it at DATABASE_URL would make it CI-runnable and is worth doing.

Three 'Data Discrepancy Handling' cases mock only ipoRepository.findBySlug/update, a shape that predates the T-307/T-318 identity-resolution rewrite (resolveIpoRow now calls findByIsin/findBySymbol/findByNormalizedName/... on the repository before ever reaching findBySlug). Fixing this needs the mock rebuilt against the CURRENT resolveIpoRow contract and its 'Data mismatch detected' log assertion re-verified against the current consolidation path, not a fixture tweak — investigated 2026-09-25 (easy-wins-2 round), left open as oversized for a test-only slice.

All five cases fail; fixtures use string ids such as 'test-ipo-e2e-001' where ipos.id is a uuid column, and the fixture rows plus every assertion are written in the OLD snake_case column shape (company_name, issue_size, field_name, existing_source, ...) that predates the camelCase schema and the current consolidatedUpsertIPO/ScrapedIPO API — investigated 2026-09-25: the visible id-type failure is one symptom of a whole-file shape mismatch, not a self-contained fixture fix. Also confirmed a second, separate bug in tests/test-utils/db.ts (getTestDb's DB-name fallback evaluates `TEST_DB_NAME || DATABASE_NAME + '_test'`, which — operator precedence — always resolves to 'ipodhan_test_test' once DATABASE_NAME is set) that would need fixing regardless; left open as oversized for a test-only slice.
